This was a very enjoyable trail following the winding path of the Rouge River. There are many photo opportunities along the way, notably at the lookout tower early in, as well as several places where the trail comes close to the river. The final loop past the bio-gas plant is a nice change from forest to grassland. A couple of watch outs: the recent warm weather has created many small flooded or muddy areas at the north section of this route. The southern portion has you stepping over tree roots and go up/down some steep hills. Either way, be sure you have good footwear. The spur at the southern tip of the AllTrails route isn’t really necessary unless you parked at the Glen Rouge campground; it doesn’t offer any unique views. Finally, as the day was getting late I took the shortcut (waypoint 2) to save a bit of time.
